implementation: Exact records.tceq.texas.gov external GET_FILE dID route, strict query and host policy, HTTPS, pinned public DNS, Host/SNI, redirect revalidation, PDF media/signature and byte bounds.
TCEQ NSR/temp listing and document requests use the secure helper; internally-created clients disable trust_env.

Stable-project NSR rows with malformed date or required permit/applicant/facility fields are isolated into identity-preserving partial_snapshot diagnostics while valid siblings remain available. Unsafe links, duplicate identities, row shape/count ambiguity, and unidentifiable malformed rows remain fatal.

Unavailable or budget-skipped TCEQ PDFs retain source identity and bounded rejection metadata; service layer must persist those diagnostics, expose partial health and skip snapshot reconciliation whenever partial_snapshot is present.
live_evidence: Pinned helper GET of official dID 7474076 returned 200 application/pdf, 572150 bytes, %PDF-1.7.
Live NSR listing adapter probe with summary budget 0 returned 328 rows, including 7 relevant presence-only rows.
Live temporary batch listing adapter probe with notice budget 0 returned 2 presence-only rows.
Houston latest weekly report was 2026-09-07; live adapter reported publisher stale by over 30 days on 2026-10-22.

validation.command: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check on six owned source/test files
git diff --check on six owned source/test files

security_test_coverage: www and records route success; DNS pinning; Host/SNI and Host restoration; hostname suffix, userinfo, non-443, IP host, private and mixed DNS answers, duplicate/unknown query, path traversal, raw control, invalid redirects, redirect loop bound, bad media type, bad PDF signature, and response byte bound.
discovery_gap: The active listing sources do not expose a records dID mapping; no discovery/join was invented. The helper is ready for an explicit verified records document URL.
limitations: Service integration remains outstanding in root-owned files. Houston publisher freshness is an external blocker; no freshness relaxation was made.
